verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents GDPR-oriented deletion/retrieval APIs and EU data residency options, giving users nominal control over data retention and deletion (mixpanel-docs-12, mixpanel-docs-38). However, community evidence shows a 2025 security breach where an attacker exfiltrated customer data via employee phishing, and Mixpanel's own major customer (OpenAI) publicly terminated its use of Mixpanel citing insufficient security/privacy accountability, directly undermining trust in Mixpanel's actual privacy posture despite the documented compliance tooling.
